reviews.text: They were amazing! I have a little teacup Yorkie that started biting everyone. She had had a neck surgery 2 years ago so I was very concerned about leaving her anywhere but Juan and Melissa were amazing they took really good care of her. She was a different dog when I picked her up. I was very pleasantly surprised ! It shows they took really good care of her and gave me long instructions on how to continue the training. They also do dog boarding so I will certainly leave Bali with them again. She had so much fun and was very loved.
The owner, Juan, was friendly and very accommodating for needs of my pet Charlie. Deeply appreciate the love and care they provided to my golden. Thank you !!!
This is the only place I will rake my dog to when I am away... Juan is a great dude and they treat Bruce great...

Amazing place. I was so nervous to leave our German shepherd puppy for the first time. I said no to a few places before being recommended this place. The owner is fair, trustworthy and knows what he’s doing. Along with his daughter. Taking vacations are not stressful at all when it comes to having a place to leave our pup now. I know he’ll be taken care of and getting some training. They truly care about your pet here.
Need open early,right now is from 9:00 to 5:00 pm.

I adopted a pitbull mix from the shelter about a year ago that had absolutely no training. I tried training her at home as much as I could but eventually realized I didn’t have the skills to do it. One of my coworkers recommended West Point K-9 and I’m so thankful for them. I did the board and train option and am so happy with the results. They really work with you to make sure you have all the tools and skills you need to be consistent with your dog. My dog loved coming in every weekend after we picked her up for the weekly sessions. Definitely a worth it investment.

We had an in incident with our Golden Retriever and quickly realized he needed more training than we were doing. My boss recommended West Point since she has taken her dog there for training. From the first visit I loved the grounds and Melissa and Juan. We ended up having to leave our baby there for 3 weeks (which I wasn’t sure I would be able to survive but I knew it was best). Marcos the trainer was working with our dog as well and Juan and Melissa and they were amazing! They kept us informed sent us videos and pictures and we were able to visit as often as we liked. We took our baby home Saturday and I can see a HUGE difference in him already.  We truly love the whole staff! They were super professional and treated our dog like one of their own. I recommend West Point 10000% and will bring any dogs we have in the future directly to them for training! They have clients for life!
I will take all my dogs and recommend everyone we know. Been around many years and knows all about every dog. Training services are exceptional

One word to describe this place is AMAZING! Our family owns a Belgian Malnois,  Maverick and it is so hard to find somebody that he likes and truly knows to care for him while we are away, but this place is amazing and Maverick loves it!

We have been boarding our Malinois at West Point K9 for years, and we couldn’t be happier with the care they receive. The facility is always spotless, well-maintained, and designed to provide a comfortable and safe environment for all dogs. Juany is absolutely amazing—he is not only knowledgeable but also incredibly kind and understanding with the dogs, always making sure they feel at ease. Our dogs are excited every time they arrive, which speaks volumes about the care and attention they receive. We highly recommend West Point K9 to anyone looking for a top-notch boarding facility. It’s truly a home away from home for our furry family members!

I have been a client for 25 years. I have taken many dogs for both boarding and training and I have nothing but good things to say about how my dogs have been treated and how well they have been trained.  The kennels are spotless as are the premises and his employees all of them are caring and loving towards the dogs. I highly recommend them.

Recently picked up my dog Milo from West Point K9 academy, he really enjoyed his time there. He was skillfully trained by Mel and Juan. The facility looked great and I felt very comfortable leaving him there. I recommend any dog owners to board and train your dog with them.

Absolutely love, and trust Juan and Melissa so much! Have been taking my dogs there for many years and wouldn’t leave them anywhere else for boarding or training. My German shepherd went from night to do in behavior, after extensive training and I have the utmost peace of mind when leaving on vacation and knowing she is there. (The non stop tail wagging says it all when I drop her off). Can’t go wrong and the many years they have been there says it all! Ty guys!!!!! <3

I have known Juan for many years and I always have known how much he loves to work with the dogs. I as a rescuer in Miami, had used his facility for over 10 years and I have never had any issues with them. I personally have recommended West Point K-9 academy to many friends of mine. They have done a great job with my rescued dogs. This is my experience with them and their staff. Always friendly, cordial and helpful. 👍👍💯

I cannot say enough good things about this business! My dog olive, would not potty outside the cage. She was rescued and gave me the hardest time to potty train, until Melissa trained her. She dedicated so much time and discipline with my dog that she would be more excited to see her than me sometimes. We created such a great bond that now she even goes there for boarding, there’s no other place I trust with my dog. This is a great family business and it shows in the love they give their dogs.

I have had two dogs at West Point K-9 for Boarding and training.    They have been very well taken care of and I was very happy with the training. There is room to play in the fenced in playground. The kennels are very clean and airy.   The staff is very caring towards the dogs. Highly recommend it.

I saw Juan’s truck drive by me on us1 one day and decided to give the kennel a call to help with my dog Rocko’s behavior.
Melissa was attentive to setup an evaluation which was free, come
up with an approximation on how long it would take to train Rocko, the entire staff was friendly and seem to really care. I can now enjoy walks with Rocko on south beach every evening and will definitely use them when I travel for over night stay in future !!

If you are looking for a family friendly place to train your dog, well you found your place. Westgate K-9 Academy was a God sent to my dog referred by our vet and obedience trainer. He needed a behavioral training because he was becoming reactive and I can’t say enough how happy we are with the change in our dog. Our dog was boarded for almost 4 weeks and trained by Marcos and other staff. They did a phenomenal job! The dogs on site were well taken care of, fed, walked, and loved by everyone that works there. I would call every day and Juan, the owner, would always answer and give me daily updates on our fur baby. I highly recommend this location if you are looking to train a dog. They do protective training as well and so much more.
The property is also very clean and so are the large cages that the dogs stay in. My dog is an indoor dog and he was so happy there. There is a caretaker on site and yes the dogs may bark because dogs will be dogs at the end of day. I will continue to work with Westgate K-9 Academy and hands down leave my dog in boarding when needed and know that he is going to be loved just like if he was at home with me.

My dog looked terrible when I picked him up. Rushed him over to Banfield animal hospital where the bill came up to $350. Totally unacceptable. He had a fungal infection and other injuries. Do yourself a favor and avoid this establishment.

My dog got bit here by another dog and the owner said he got stabbed by a branch. When the vet shaved off the hair it was clear he had a bite mark and had to get surgery. They never refunded my money and my dog never got trained. Don’t bring your dog here.
They offer boarding as well as training. You can tell they really love dogs.

Read recent reviews please. We were considering boarding our dogs here while out of town since we live around the corner. 1) Website says there us always a caretaker on grounds.. yet we just walked our dog past the facility at 11pm on a Monday and there was several dogs barking and banging against the walls or something. No car even on the property. Strongly seemed to be just the dogs for the night. 2) the most recent reviews demostrare a trend of the dogs being returned to owners hurt and overly sedated. They mention training all temperaments of dogs but don’t mention the criteria for sedating dogs or the medically trained staff that oversees its administration in case of adverse reactions. It seems dogs they like have a great time and dogs they don’t might get drugged and disregarded. Not a chance we’re willing to take with our dogs. Reaching out to recent clients to see what injuries their dogs sustained.

My dog Teddy loves this place more than our own home. Every time he is there Mel and Juan give him the best attention. They are friendly and they know their stuff. Would highly recommend to anyone with a dog. Thank you so much!!!!

West Point K-9 Academy is the only kennel our family will use to take care of our Zoey. My family just returned from our family cruise. While on our cruise the family knew that Zoey was in great care. Juan and his staff are outstanding. The …

The worst of my experience with West Ponit K-9!!!!!
